headline: Clay casting, edible treasure hunts and small local adventures
summary: Five Bristol finds for 12–13 September, including two free Sunday community-garden and farm visits.

datedPicks.title: Clay, casting and a potter’s wheel
datedPicks.location: Spike Island, 133 Cumberland Road, Bristol BS1 6UX
datedPicks.cost: Adult £3 · children free · materials provided; check booking fees
datedPicks.ageSuitability: Organiser: all ages with adult supervision. Our guide: best for makers aged 5–12; younger children will need help.
datedPicks.description: Make clay forms by hand, with moulds or on a potter’s wheel, then explore plaster casting with art fabricators.
datedPicks.appeal: Try real sculpture-making: shape the clay, make a mould, explore a plaster cast. A hands-on workshop with materials supplied.
datedPicks.parentTip: Book ahead and check availability. Children must stay with an adult; wear clothes that can get messy.

datedPicks.title: Potions and puppets at the farm’s birthday
datedPicks.location: Windmill Hill City Farm, Philip Street, Bedminster, Bristol BS3 4EA
datedPicks.cost: Adult early bird £7.60 including fee · under-16 early bird advertised £4; check current child total
datedPicks.ageSuitability: Organiser: no age restrictions. Children attend with their grown-ups.
datedPicks.description: The city farm’s 50th anniversary brings puppet shows, animal tours, potion making, nature activities and live music.
datedPicks.appeal: A special birthday programme with potion making, puppet shows and animal tours across a working community farm.
datedPicks.parentTip: Activities are included; food and drink cost extra. Check current adult and child prices before booking, including the rule for babies.

datedPicks.title: Garden games, music and face painting
datedPicks.location: Redcatch Community Garden, Redcatch Park, Broad Walk, Knowle, Bristol BS4 2RD
datedPicks.cost: Adult £4 · child £6 · one adult + child £10 before any booking fees
datedPicks.ageSuitability: Organiser: all ages welcome in the noon–6pm session.
datedPicks.description: Redcatch’s first RCG Fest has music, cabaret, face painting and funfair games, with a drink included in the ticket.
datedPicks.appeal: A community-garden festival where games, face painting, the show and a drink are included in the ticket.
datedPicks.parentTip: Choose the family session, which ends at 18:00. Food costs extra. Ask about baby tickets; the later session is adults only.

datedPicks.title: An edible treasure hunt at Buzz Garden
datedPicks.location: Buzz Community Garden, behind Gainsborough Square, Lockleaze, Bristol BS7 9XA
datedPicks.ageSuitability: Organiser: all welcome. Our guide: curious ages 4–12 with an adult; younger children can join with help.
datedPicks.description: Hunt for edible plants, sow seeds and plant bulbs during the garden’s Get Growing Trail session.
datedPicks.appeal: Follow a treasure hunt through edible plants, then help sow seeds or plant bulbs in a hidden community garden.
datedPicks.parentTip: Enter from Bonnington Walk beside Hong Kong takeaway, following the slope behind the shops. Ask the organiser about access if needed.

datedPicks.title: Meet the animals at Bramble Farm
datedPicks.location: Bramble Farm, Beckington Walk, Knowle, Bristol BS3 5EA
datedPicks.ageSuitability: Children’s activities advertised; no exact age range given. Our guide: families with an adult, especially children who enjoy animals and growing.
datedPicks.description: A community farm open day on the Get Growing Trail, with animals, an orchard and children’s activities.
datedPicks.appeal: A small community farm tucked into the Northern Slopes, with pigs, chickens, bees and children’s activities for its open day.
datedPicks.parentTip: Organiser’s directions: use satnav BS4 1AW, then follow signs from Stockwood Crescent through the hedge onto Northern Slopes and turn right.
datedPicks.sourceName: Bristol Food Network · Get Growing Trail
